// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (113x256x256).
// Optimization: double-buffer A tiles to overlap mvin with compute,
// and move gemmini_flush + gemmini_extended3_config_ex outside all loops.
void solution(void) {
  int tiles   = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;

  // Two A buffers for double-buffering: a_base_0 and a_base_1.
  // Each A buffer needs tiles * tiles_K * DIM scratchpad rows.
  uint32_t a_base_0 = 0;
  uint32_t a_base_1 = tiles * tiles_K * DIM;

  // b_base is fixed: top of scratchpad, growing downward.
  // Must not overlap with the larger of the two A buffers (a_base_1 + tiles*tiles_K*DIM).
  // b_base = BANK_NUM*BANK_ROWS - tiles_K*tiles*DIM (unchanged from original).
  uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;

  int SPAD_DEST = 128;

  // Flush and configure execution ONCE — format never changes across tiles.
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                               1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    // --- Stage B scales ONCE per j0 ---
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
      memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

    // --- Mvin B tiles ONCE per j0 into the top of the scratchpad ---
    // Must use gemmini_extended_mvin (port 0) for loop_ws_spad compatibility.
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        gemmini_extended_mvin(
          (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
          b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

    // --- Prologue: stage A scales and mvin A tiles for i0=0 ---
    if (BLOCKS_M > 0) {
      int mrows0 = REAL_M;
      if (mrows0 > BLK) mrows0 = BLK;

      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][0], BLK);

      // Load scales for i0=0 (A into sel=0, B into sel=1).
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Mvin A tiles for i0=0 into a_base_0.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
            a_base_0 + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
    }

    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      int pad_i = BLK - mrows;
      int pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Current and next A buffer (ping-pong).
      uint32_t cur_a_base = (i0 % 2 == 0) ? a_base_0 : a_base_1;
      uint32_t nxt_a_base = (i0 % 2 == 0) ? a_base_1 : a_base_0;

      // --- Prefetch A tiles for i0+1 (issued before compute to overlap DMA with systolic array) ---
      // The mvin queues in the RoCC pipeline and runs concurrently with gemmini_loop_ws_spad below.
      // Must use gemmini_extended_mvin (port 0) for loop_ws_spad compatibility.
      if (i0 + 1 < BLOCKS_M) {
        int mrows_next = REAL_M - (i0 + 1) * BLK;
        if (mrows_next > BLK) mrows_next = BLK;
        if (mrows_next > 0) {
          gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
          for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
            for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
              gemmini_extended_mvin(
                (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + ((i0 + 1) * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                nxt_a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // --- Configure requantized mvout for current tile ---
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   tiles, tiles, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // --- Execute fused hardware matmul using cur_a_base ---
      // Scale loads for the current tile were done either in the prologue (i0=0)
      // or at the end of the previous iteration (i0>0).
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           cur_a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false, false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // --- Drain BF16 results from mx_smem to DRAM, row by row ---
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(
          &C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
          SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);

      // --- Fence: ensure all mx_read_smem DMA writes are visible before next use ---
      gemmini_fence();

      // --- Stage A scales for i0+1 and reload into hardware scale memory ---
      // Must happen after fence and before the next gemmini_loop_ws_spad.
      if (i0 + 1 < BLOCKS_M) {
        int mrows_next = REAL_M - (i0 + 1) * BLK;
        if (mrows_next > BLK) mrows_next = BLK;
        if (mrows_next > 0) {
          for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
            memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][(i0 + 1) * BLK], BLK);

          // Load A scales for i0+1 (sel=0) and B scales (sel=1, already staged).
          gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
          gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
